title: Glowing disc photographed over property

tellings.quote: Um and it you know, the first image looked almost like a Millennium Falcon. Was a disc-like object that was that was glowing.

plain: In 2016, a glowing disc was photographed over Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah's Uinta Basin known for strange reports. The ranch's owner tells this as something he witnessed. He says the first image looked almost like the Millennium Falcon, the spaceship from Star Wars.
